description:
# Bangladesh Study Abroad, Scholarship & China University Cost Benchmark Dataset (2027)

Open CC BY 4.0 higher-education benchmark published by **EduExpress International** (https://eduexpressint.com/press, Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh).

## Highlights
- **362 verified active universities** (353 in China across 93 cities, 9 in Malaysia)
- **1796 structured degree & language programs** with explicit tuition and medium of instruction
- **682 structured university scholarship rows** with parsed waiver types, dorm/insurance waivers, and separate stipends
- **1497 itemized non-tuition fee rows** kept strictly separate from tuition
- **32-country global Bangladesh outbound matrix** (12 active EduExpress countries + 20 top OECD/regional benchmark destinations) with 2026/27 statutory visa solvency rules
- **54 Bangladesh-eligible flagship national & institutional scholarships** across all 32 countries
